scope: One AMD CPU attribution pass, excluded from all headline speed decisions
waveform_reference: Exact bytes of this candidate from its completed 3-clip screen, verified by SHA256; no FP32 equivalence claim

ORT_profile.time_units: ORT timestamps and durations are microseconds
ORT_profile.percentage_denominator: Sum of selected kernel-event durations, not wall time; overlapping events can double count
ORT_profile.profiling_overhead_caveat: Profiling adds tracing/scheduling overhead. These values locate bottlenecks and must not replace unprofiled headline RTF.

gpu_library_mappings.scope: Read /proc/self/maps only; no device query. Mapped libraries alone do not prove GPU execution.

limits.GEMM: Library integer GEMM including internal packing; public API does not expose a separate packing timer
limits.row_remainder: Dequantization, allocation, bounds checks and attribution overhead, combined
limits.denominator: Summed worker-call durations overlap and are not fractions of decoder wall time
